system_overview: legal-doc-redactor is a on-prem PII redaction for legal PDFs with review queue. It is built as a small focused system with PII Detector (regex+NER) at its core, supported by Redaction Renderer and Review Queue.

recommended_language.rationale: Rust fits the on-prem PII redaction for legal PDFs with review queue workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use PII Detector (regex+NER) as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The on-prem PII redaction for legal PDFs with review queue hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Review Queue asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Document, Finding, ReviewTask must persist relationally
Components: PII Detector (regex+NER), Redaction Renderer, Review Queue
